entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-07-30
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • UpdateServiceWorkerFileWithVersion task runs after static asset compression #50001
  • [IMPROVEMENT] Warn about TargetFramework and TargetFrameworks both being set #49998
  • `PublishAot=true` and `IncludeNativeLibrariesForSelfExtract=true` should produce a warning #49995
  • Make sure `StaticWebAssetMakeReferencedAssetOriginalItemSpecAbsolute` for wasm apps is not empty #49992

Closed

  • '--no-build' flag messes with 'dotnet run' error messages #24591
  • [NETSDKE2E][Regression]With 10.0.100-preview.7.25363.101, .NET crashes when running 'dotnet nuget locals all --clear' #49764
  • Update MSTest in test templates (template_feed directory) to 3.10.0 #49856

PullRequests

Created

  • Crossgen NetAnalyzers and Razor generators #50003
  • [watch] Fix /bl option parsing, use it for build logging #50002
    Area-Watch
  • add System.Net.Http.WasmEnableStreamingResponse to RuntimeHostConfigurationOption #50000
    arch-wasm
  • Exclude default items from file-based apps in project dirs #49999
    Area-run-file
  • Add StaticWebAssetMakeReferencedAssetOriginalItemSpecAbsolute property to WasmSdk #49994
    10.0.1xx
  • Avoid unnecessary evaluations during `dotnet run file.cs` #49991
    Area-run-file

Merged

  • Send Ctrl+C to launched process before killing it on Windows #49847
    Area-AspNetCore
  • Fix --no-build flag error message inconsistency for non-existent project files #49544
  • allow reading uid from ContainerUser to set the Tar entry uid #49770
    Area-Containers
  • Update xlf copilot instructions #49780
    Area-Infrastructure
  • NuGet's dotnet cli commands should use common interactive option #49944
    Area-CLI
  • make dicts in NamedPipeBase strong typed #49984
  • Update MSTest in test templates (template_feed directory) to 3.10.0 #49987

Updated

  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #49947
    Area-AspNetCore, Area-CodeFlow
  • Update the minimum msbuild version for .NET 10 #49531
  • Remove MSBuild hacks for virtual project building #49745
    Area-run-file
  • Move pruning defaults back to the NuGet.targets #49943
  • Cleanup DOTNET_ROOT logic for dotnet run #49913
  • [release/10.0.1xx-preview7] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #49954
    Area-AspNetCore
